**Causality** — causation and the structure of causal relations — causal order, definite and indefinite, and its combinatorics, topology and geometry; sheaf- and process-theoretic accounts of causality; causal models, causal inference and interventionist accounts of what a causal relation is; and the metaphysics of causation — exclusion, mental causation, causal emergence and closure, reciprocal causation (ADR-035).

| [SYNTHESIS-009](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-009.md) v2 | Records kept of each capacity a response needs bound a reserve's readiness for a contingency between the sum of their probabilities less one less their number and the weakest of them, and identify it only when the capacities' dependence is known, so for any verdict that rises with readiness they can refute a required readiness when the weakest capacity falls below it and certify it only when the capacities' shortfalls together stay within its margin, leaving the band between to joint evidence such as a deadline-bound exercise; where capacities only decay between record and need, a refutation outlasts the record and a certification does not | [QUESTION-395](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-395.md) asks which observations tell a warranted reserve of specialized capability from wasteful redundancy, and which of them identify readiness ([TERM-115](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-115.md)) and which only bound it. [CLAIM-587](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-587.md) makes a response the conjunction of complementary capacities. So records kept per capacity (rosters, training assessments, equipment availability, turnout times) fix only the marginals, which bound readiness by the Fréchet inequalities and do not identify it. A record can refute a required readiness through the weakest capacity, and can certify it only when the shortfalls sum within the margin; between those, only joint evidence decides. With [CLAIM-558](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-558.md)'s decay, a certification expires with the record's age and a refutation does not.
